shots.text: Over Aurvanis we brought down the Thunderhead, a storm gone solid as black glass. It was Aurath's madness. It shattered, and for the first time in a month the rain fell with no lightning in it.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The black solid cloud shattering, frozen lightning falling like glass. Rain. Riders lifting their faces to it.

shots.text:
A voice I knew told me my riders had betrayed me. So I struck them down, camp by camp.

Never again. My winds are yours.
shots.speaker: aurath
shots.art_note: Aurath, a rider-shape of cloud and lightning, flickering, bowing over the towers.

shots.text: The dead riders fell from their horses where they stood. The Galeborn rode home to Aurvanis. Two lands were free.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Lightning-horses going out like blown candles on the plateau. Galeborn raising their tents again at Aurvanis; Kaela watching from her horse.
